topic.title: Risk-to-Reward Is a Planning Tool, Not a Win-Rate Promise

research.summary: Reward-to-risk compares a planned potential gain with a planned potential loss. It does not tell you how often a setup wins, and real fills can differ because of costs or slippage. Evaluate a method over a meaningful sample, include expenses, and avoid treating one ratio as proof of an edge.
